description: Use this for ANY Swiss address, even without a listing – «what is it like to live at …», «is it noisy», «schools/Kita/ÖV near …», «was gibt es rund um …», «quartier calme ?», «com'è la zona …»: the building (year, floors, flats, heating), public transport, everyday places within walking distance, road/rail noise, local prices and rents, construction nearby, and listings in or near the building.

language.description: Language of titles, descriptions and links (default de). Use the user's language.

title: Everything about an address
